summary.result: The statistical parameters indicated that the model provided a reasonable estimation of the runoff at the study watershed.
summary.background: The objective of this paper was to evaluate the auto-calibration with multi-objective optimization method to calibrate the parameters of the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) model.
summary.method: The model was calibrated and validated by using nine years (1996-2004) of measured data for the 384-ha Baran reservoir subwatershed located in central Korea.
